notes.title: Version 1.1 is available now!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35324319/bedcdcc5fc43603c8eda65ad6759450b8403e358.jpg[/img]
Today we released a big update for the game. In addition to fixing small bugs, a new control system was added, now you can completely control the character with mouse (without using a keyboard or gamepad), the ability to increase the speed of the player, move the camera around the scene, more tutorials in each chapter. Some levels from the first and third chapters were removed, which seemed very long to many players, and leaderboards (spies and informants) were added.

Important: Now the update is available only for PC, within 1-2 days the version for Mac will be downloaded, and the updated demo version of the game.

notes.title: Spy Tactics is out!
notes.content:
You can buy it right now with a 10% launch discount.

Thank you for waiting!

The game was developed for about a year and I hope that you all will like the game. The most important thing in such games is interesting and challenging levels, there are more than 45 levels in the game, and each of them as a new challenge. In each chapter, the difficulty will increase, you will have to break the door locks, learn new enemies, hack computer terminals and much more.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Cuuz0Lgcd-Q][/url]

All these levels are connected by a small plot. You are going to try yourself as a special agent and carry out secret missions in different places of the world – elimination of the corrupted officials and criminal bosses, search of the missing works of art, destruction of the hidden computer servers and chemical laboratories and many other things. We all really hope that you have a good time in the game.

[i][b]Supervoid.[/b][/i]

notes.title: Spy Tactics Announcement
notes.content:
Hello guys, after a year of development we announce our new game. Spy Tactics is a mix of puzzle and turn-based strategy about fascinating adventures of a spy. 

https://youtu.be/Cuuz0Lgcd-Q

Spy Tactics has about 45+ story levels. Which we tried to make as complex and interesting as possible. Very little is left before the release, and now you can play the demo, where 8 levels are available. If you find any bugs in the demo, please contact us.

[i][b]Supervoid.[/b][/i]
